arxiv-1809-08045.description:
A 2018 arXiv research paper by Dominik Dold a,b,1,2, Ilja Bytschok a,1, Akos F. Kungl a,b, Andreas Baumbach a, Oliver Breitwieser a, Walter Senn b, Johannes Schemmel a, Karlheinz Meier a, Mihai A. Petrovici a,b,1,2 a Kirchhoff-Institute for Physics, Heidelberg University. b Department of Physiology, University of Bern. 1 Authors . Abstract

An increasing body of evidence suggests that the trial-to-trial variability of spiking activity in the brain is not mere noise, but rather the reflection of a sampling-based encoding scheme for probabilistic computing.

arxiv-2210-15846.title: Technical Q&A Site Answer Recommendation via Question Boosting Journal: TOSEM Volume: 9 4 39 3 9 DOI: 0000001.0000001 Note: Corresponding Authors: Xin Xia CCS: Software and its engineering Software evolution CCS: Software and its engineering Maintaining software
arxiv-2210-15846.creator: Zhipeng GAO, Xin Xia, David Lo, John Grundy
arxiv-2210-15846.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Zhipeng GAO, Xin Xia, David Lo, John Grundy. Software developers have heavily used online question and answer platforms to seek help to solve their technical problems. However, a major problem with these technical Q&A sites is "answer hungriness" i.e., a large number of questions remain unanswered or unresolved, and users have to wait for a long time or painstakingly go through the provided answers with various levels of quality.

arxiv-2402-15122.creator: S. H. Lee, H. W. Joo, H. J. Kim, K. W. Kim, S. K. Kim, Y. D. Kim, Y. J. Ko, H. S. Lee, J. Y. Lee, H. S. Park, Y. S. Yoon
arxiv-2402-15122.description: Abstract Elastic scattering off nuclei in target detectors, involving interactions with dark matter and coherent elastic neutrino nuclear recoil (CE ν \nu NS), results in the deposition of low energy within the nuclei, dissipating rapidly through a combination of heat and ionization.

arxiv-2405-03162.title: Advancing Multimodal Medical Capabilities of Gemini
arxiv-2405-03162.creator: Google Research and Google DeepMind
arxiv-2405-03162.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Google Research and Google DeepMind. Many clinical tasks require an understanding of specialized data, such as medical images and genomics, which is not typically found in general-purpose large multimodal models. Building upon Gemini’s multimodal models, we develop several models within the new Med-Gemini family that inherit core capabilities of Gemini and are optimized for medical use via fine-tuning with 2D and 3D radiology, histopathology, ophthalmology, dermatology and genomic data.

arxiv-2410-03296.title: Comparing zero-shot self-explanations with human rationales in text classification
arxiv-2410-03296.creator: Stephanie BrandlCenter for Social Data ScienceUniversity of Copenhagen stephanie.brandl@sodas.ku.dk, Oliver EberleMachine Learning GroupTechnische Universität Berlin oliver.eberle@tu-berlin.de
arxiv-2410-03296.description: Abstract Instruction-tuned LLMs are able to provide an explanation about their output to users by generating self-explanations. These do not require gradient computations or the application of possibly complex XAI methods. In this paper, we analyse whether this ability results in a good explanation.

arxiv-2508-06781.title: BiXSE: Improving Dense Retrieval via Probabilistic Graded Relevance Distillation
arxiv-2508-06781.creator: Christos Tsirigotis, Vaibhav Adlakha, João Monteiro, Aaron C. Courville, Perouz Taslakian
arxiv-2508-06781.description: Abstract Neural sentence embedding models for dense retrieval typically rely on binary relevance labels, treating query-document pairs as either relevant or irrelevant. However, real-world relevance often exists on a continuum, and recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have made it feasible to scale the generation of fine-grained graded relevance labels.

pmc-10796124.title: Vital role of autophagy flux inhibition of placental trophoblast cells in pregnancy disorders induced by HEV infection
pmc-10796124.creator: Yifei Yang, Bo Liu, Jijing Tian, Xuepeng Teng, Tianlong Liu
pmc-10796124.description: Hepatitis E virus (HEV) has become one of the important pathogens that threaten the global public health. Type 3 and 4 HEV are zoonotic, which can spread vertically and cause placental damage. At the same time, autophagy plays an important role in the process of embryo development and pregnancy maintenance.

pmc-11311766.title: Telomere Length, Telomerase Activity, and Vaginal Microbiome in Patients with HPV-Related Precancerous Lesions
pmc-11311766.creator: Ewa Boniewska-Bernacka, Anna Pańczyszyn, Grzegorz Głąb, Anna Goc, Shun-Fa Yang, Shih-Chi Su
pmc-11311766.description: Persistent high-risk human papillomaviruses (HR HPVs) infection leads to the development of squamous intraepithelial lesions in cervical cells that may lead to cancer. The telomere length, telomerase activity, and species composition of the vaginal microbiome may influence the dynamic of changes and the process of carcinogenesis.

pmc-11444219.title: Patterns of Poly-Victimization Among Early Adolescents: A Latent Class and Two-Wave Latent Transition Analysis
pmc-11444219.creator: Jiajun Zhou, Yandong Luo, Ping Chang, Liping Li
pmc-11444219.description: BackgroundPoly-victimization involves more than just counting incidents; it varies in severity and type among adolescents and can change over time.ObjectiveThe aim is to identify latent classes of poly-victimization among children in early adolescence, investigate transition probabilities between these latent categories, and examine the influencing factors.

pmc-11500007.title: Deficiencies in corin and atrial natriuretic peptide-mediated signaling impair endochondral ossification in bone development
pmc-11500007.creator: Zibin Zhou, Xiaoyu Mao, Chun Jiang, Wenguo Li, Tiantian Zhou, Meng Liu, Shijin Sun, Mengting Wang, Ningzheng Dong, Qingyu Wu, Haibin Zhou
pmc-11500007.description: Corin is a protease that activates atrial natriuretic peptide (ANP), a hormone in cardiovascular homeostasis. Structurally, ANP is similar to C-type natriuretic peptide (CNP) crucial in bone development. Here, we examine the role of corin and ANP in chondrocyte differentiation and bone formation.

pmc-11715047.title: Contrast of Early Phase Amyloid PET
pmc-11715047.creator: Masashi Kameyama, Muneyuki Sakata, Kenji Ishibashi, Tetsuro Tago, Yuto Kamitaka, Jun Toyohara, Kenji Ishii
pmc-11715047.description: BackgroundThe method of obtaining pseudo‐cerebral blood flow images from the initial minutes of amyloid PET scans has been proposed. This technique proves to be highly valuable as it not only indicates the presence of amyloid accumulation but also reveals sites of neurodegeneration. However, the obtained early images represent the K1 image rather than cerebral blood flow.

pmc-12603299.title: ATF6 and pS6K as prognostic biomarkers in newly diagnosed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
pmc-12603299.creator: Shuang Su, Lili Wu, Chen Huang, Lianjing Wang, Weijing Li, Wei Liu, Lihong Liu
pmc-12603299.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study aimed to investigate the clinical and prognostic significance of activating transcription factor 6 (ATF6) and phosphorylated S6 kinase (pS6K) expression in newly diagnosed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL). We conducted a retrospective analysis of 107 DLBCL patients treated with the R-CHOP regimen at the Department of Hematology, Fourth Hospital of Hebei Medical University, between January 2019 and December 2022.

pmc-12668678.title: Placebo rates in randomized clinical trials of ulcerative colitis: an individual patient data meta-analysis
pmc-12668678.creator: Virginia Solitano, Malcolm Hogan, Siddharth Singh, Silvio Danese, Laurent Peyrin-Biroulet, Sudheer Vuyyuru, John K Macdonald, Guangyong Zou, Yuhong Yuan, Bruce E Sands, Remo Panaccione, Brian G Feagan, Jurij Hanzel, Rocio Sedano, Parambir Dulai, Neeraj Narula, Christopher Ma, Vipul Jairath
pmc-12668678.description: Background and AimsWe assessed placebo rates and associated factors using individual patient data (IDP) from randomized clinical trials (RCTs) in ulcerative colitis (UC).MethodsWe conducted an IPD meta-analysis using Vivli and Yale University Open Data Access data-sharing platforms. Phase 2 and 3 RCTs of advanced biologics in adults with moderate-to-severe UC published since 2010 were included.

pmc-13062015.title: Inhibition of CDK9 sensitizes multidrug resistant ovarian cancer cells to paclitaxel
pmc-13062015.creator: Jinglu Wang, Francis J Hornicek, Huirong Shi, Wenlong Feng, Zhenfeng Duan
pmc-13062015.description: Multidrug resistance is the major cause of treatment failure in ovarian cancer. Overexpression of cyclin-dependent kinase (CDK) 9 has been observed in a variety of cancers and promotes tumor cell growth and proliferation by regulating transcription. However, the role of CDK9 in drug resistance of ovarian cancer remains unknown.

pmc-13274353.title: Early supplemental feeding improves post-weaning growth restriction in lambs via the gastrointestinal-metabolic axis
pmc-13274353.creator: Lele Zhu, Mengmeng Wang, Xinyue Zhang, Tingting Dou, Heng Hua, Xinyue Tang, Xiaoyu Niu, Qifang Kou, Yulin Chen, Menghao Pan, Baohua Ma
pmc-13274353.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The weaning period often induces growth restriction in lambs due to gastrointestinal immaturity and dietary transition. Although early supplemental feeding (ESF) shows promise, its systemic mechanisms via the rumen microbiota-gut-metabolism axis remain incompletely understood. Sixty Tan lambs were assigned to a control group (suckling only), Trial Group I (free-access ESF from 10 days), and Trial Group II (free-access + forced isolation from 15 days). Growth performance, rumen fermentation, intestinal morphology, serum metabolites, and rumen microbiota were comprehensively analyzed.

pmc-13350679.title: Synthesizing cone-beam projections in radiotherapy using deep learning network for patients with head and neck cancer
pmc-13350679.creator: Yuhan Fan, Peng Huang, Jiawen Shang, Zhixing Chang, Zhihui Hu, Ke Zhang, Xin Xie, Zhiqiang Liu, Hui Yan

pmc-13520090.title: Reconstructing the interosseous ligament: A technique using a single bundle synthetic tape
pmc-13520090.creator: Enrico Carità, Clelia Rota, Vasiliki Batsou, Mara Laterza, Alberto Donadelli
pmc-13520090.description: Reconstruction of the interosseous membrane of the forearm has gained popularity over recent decades and several surgical techniques have been described to treat the longitudinal instability of the forearm after an Essex-Lopresti injury (ELI). We propose a synthetic reconstruction of the interosseous ligament (IOL) with double Arthrex FiberTape® and present data from cadaveric specimens used to test the reconstruction.

pmc-13674722.title: Early‐Life Betaine Supplementation Drives Sex‐Specific Metabolic Programming in Rats, Affecting FGF21 Signaling and Energy Balance
pmc-13674722.creator: Rocío A Martín‐Chamorro, Catalina A Pomar, Andreu Palou, Catalina Picó, Ana M Rodríguez
pmc-13674722.description: We aimed to evaluate the effects of maternal diet and betaine supplementation during the suckling period on Fgf21 expression and metabolic pathways related to FGF21 signaling and metabolic programming. Offspring of Wistar rats fed either a chow diet (CD) or a Western diet (WD) were studied at postnatal day 22 and at 7 months.

uslaw-usc-t50-s1514.title: 50 U.S.C. § 1514 — “United States” defined
uslaw-usc-t50-s1514.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t50-s1514.description: United States Code, Title 50 (War And National Defense); Chapter 32 (Chemical And Biological Warfare Program). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Unless otherwise indicated, as used in this section 1 [50 U.S.C. 1512, 1513–1515, 1517] the term “United States” means the several States the District of Columbia, and the territories and possessions of the United States.
